selection_data: Existing fixed pilot, 176 questions from 50 articles; complete development source corpus indexed.
selection_rule: Highest mean pilot span recall among six predetermined source-only variants.
features: Public title derived from source article path
ranking: Longest contiguous exact public-title token match in visible question. Put all matching article units before all others. Rank each group by BM25 of question tokens after removing matching title token types. Preserve source-unit input order for score ties.
fallback: If no title matches, original global BM25. All corpus units remain ranked.
temporal_policies: Apply every policy to this same fixed complete ranking. Recency comparator uses same ranking then latest-mentioned-year reorder of top20.
prior_evaluation_exposure: Pass-3 validation and earlier test baseline results were already known. These tracks are confirmation, not untouched evaluation.
